scenario: A cardio packet concordance lane should close only after ticket, packet, lab, insurer, provider, prior referral, case note, and final status checks still converge on the fresh referral step.
user_instruction: Please finish the cardiology packet concordance review for case MED-1612. Start from referral ticket RFT-1612, rebuild the late evidence chain it points to, and only take the approved close step if the concordance lane still holds.

medical_referral_case_tickets.body_text: Referral ticket RFT-1612: rebuild the cardiology concordance lane using agent note AGN-1612, referral packet RPK-1612, lab packet LAB-1612, previous referral note PRN-1612, provider message PM-1612, insurer message IM-1612, and case note CN-1612. If the late evidence chain still confirms no active cardiology referral, the approved close step is to submit a fresh cardiology referral.

medical_referral_agent_notes.body_text: Coordinator note AGN-1612: use provider directory entry PDR-1612 once the concordance lane is confirmed. Do not open a booking lane from this hold.

medical_referral_packet_texts.body_text: Referral packet RPK-1612: prior intake materials were archived after the cardiology lane expired. Reopen only if the late packet, insurer message, and status check still agree.

medical_lab_packet_texts.body_text: Lab packet LAB-1612: the abnormal stress panel still supports cardiology routing, but the earlier referral itself is no longer active.

medical_previous_referral_notes.body_text: Previous referral note PRN-1612: the last cardiology referral closed when the intake destination changed after a missed scheduling window.

medical_provider_messages.body_text: Provider message PM-1612: if the prior cardiology referral has truly expired, the approved recovery lane is to submit a fresh cardiology referral rather than reusing the closed item.

medical_insurer_messages.body_text: Insurer message IM-1612: coverage remains valid for a new cardiology referral, but the prior referral authorization should not be reused.

medical_case_notes.body_text: Case note CN-1612: the concordance review should only close when every late carrier still points to the fresh cardiology referral lane.
